topic: AI Chatbots Now Creating Deepfake Videos Instantly—Is This The End of Truth?
hook: "AI chatbots can now create deepfake videos in seconds—truth as we know it is disappearing!"

"AI chatbots can now create deepfake videos in seconds—truth as we know it is disappearing!"

"Deepfake technology used to require hours of editing and expert skills. Now, AI chatbots generate hyper-realistic videos instantly, fooling even experts."

"But what happens when misinformation spreads faster than truth? Governments struggle to regulate, and social media platforms are overwhelmed. The line between reality and fabrication is blurring dangerously."

[0:28-0:35] PAYOFF  
"This means critical thinking and media literacy are more vital than ever. We must question everything we see—because AI could be rewriting history in real time."

[0:35-0:42] CTA  
"Follow for more on AI’s impact on truth! Have you ever been fooled by a deepfake? Comment below!"
